frameworks.name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
frameworks.purpose: Voluntary framework to manage AI risk across the lifecycle and promote trustworthy AI.

frameworks.name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 AIMS
frameworks.purpose: Certifiable AI management system standard aligning AI governance with organizational management.

frameworks.name: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
frameworks.purpose: Most critical security risks in LLM applications and technical mitigations.
frameworks.notes: 2026 edition (2026-08-03). LLM01 Prompt Injection, LLM02 Sensitive Information Disclosure, LLM03 Excessive Agency (up from 6th), LLM04 Supply Chain, LLM05 Data & Model Poisoning, LLM06 Unbounded Consumption, LLM07 Misinformation, LLM08 Hidden Context Exposure, LLM09 Vector & Embedding Weaknesses, LLM10 Improper Output Handling.

frameworks.name: MITRE ATLAS
frameworks.purpose: Knowledge base of adversary tactics and techniques specific to AI/ML systems.
frameworks.notes: Extends ATT&CK concepts to ML systems.

frameworks.name: EU Artificial Intelligence Act
frameworks.purpose: Comprehensive risk-based legal framework for AI in the EU.

frameworks.name: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications
frameworks.purpose: Top risks specific to agentic AI systems including tooling, delegation, memory, and autonomy.
frameworks.notes: 2026 edition (ASI01-ASI10). Complements the LLM Top 10; use both when a model acts as an agent with tools, memory, and downstream consequences.
